definitions.gloss: offer; approach (of work, a role, or a contract)
definitions.explanation: An approach made to someone with a concrete proposal — a job, a transfer, a part in a production, an appearance on a program. From English "offer", but narrower: it is used for work and contracts, not for offers of help or of goods for sale.

examples.japanese: オファー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けた→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧。
⟦{他社|たしゃ}→他社：17803_tasha⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧オファー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|き}ている→来る：00254_kuru⟧。
examples.english: I have an offer from another company.

examples.japanese: ⟦{条件|じょうけん}→条件：03285_jouken⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{合|あ}わなかった→合う：10466_au⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧オファー⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: The terms didn't suit me, so I decided to turn down this offer.

notes:
Business and entertainment-industry vocabulary. Also used as a suru-verb (オファー⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧, to make an offer), though the noun is far more common.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- オファー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}ける→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧: to accept an offer
- オファー⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{断|ことわ}る→断る：02102_kotowaru⟧: to turn down an offer
- オファー⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{来|く}る→来る：00254_kuru⟧: an offer comes in
- ⟦{出演|しゅつえん}→出演：11732_shutsuen⟧オファー: an offer to appear (on a program, in a film)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{申|もう}し{出|で}→申し出：13560_moushide⟧: offer, proposal — plain Japanese, and it can be an offer of help as well as of work
- ⟦{内定|ないてい}→内定：07499_naitei⟧: informal job offer — specifically a company's advance decision to hire a new graduate
